meta.sample_note: Sample data. Figures are illustrative except where a field is marked real.
meta.source: Call assessment 2026-10-26 and vendor docs; sources checked 2026-10-26

integrations.name: WooCommerce (mandmvinyl.com)
integrations.need: A read-only API key from WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API, stored in her own account.

integrations.name: Kixxl gang sheet builder
integrations.method: Unknown. Orders reach WooCommerce; Kixxl-side data may need an export or a support request.
integrations.need: Ask Kixxl support whether an export, API, or webhook exists. Until then, gang sheet counts come from WooCommerce order lines.

sources.label: Kixxl on Shopify App Store (no public API found)

integrations.name: Shopkeep point of sale
integrations.method: Daily CSV export or API, if available
integrations.need: Check inside Shopkeep for a reports export. No public Shopkeep API docs were found. Until confirmed, store sales are a weekly manual upload.

integrations.name: PayPal and Venmo
integrations.need: A PayPal business login to create read-only REST credentials, and a look at why Venmo and PayPal fail (plugin settings, domain verification, account limits).

integrations.name: Apple Pay and Google Pay
flows_in: Wallet payments through the card processor
integrations.method: Through the card processor, shown with WooCommerce orders
integrations.need: Pick the processor and turn the wallets on. Not live yet.
integrations.cost: Processor fees (estimate: standard card rate; confirm on the processor's page)

integrations.name: FedEx
integrations.method: FedEx Ship, Rate and Track APIs on her account
integrations.need: Her FedEx account number and a developer project linked to it. Opening an account has no fee.
integrations.cost: No API fee listed for Ship and Rate

integrations.name: UPS
integrations.need: Her UPS account number linked to a UPS developer app.

integrations.name: Google Business Profile
integrations.need: Manager access on her profile and an API access request (Google reviews requests).

integrations.name: Facebook and Instagram
integrations.method: Meta Graph API, or manual weekly numbers
integrations.need: Decide if social numbers belong here. Kept light until capacity catches up.

integrations.name: Texting service
integrations.method: Twilio-style API called by the automation when an order turns Ready
integrations.need: Desiree approves the service and per-message fees first. Business texting registration is required for US numbers.
integrations.cost: About $0.012 a message to AT&T numbers at list price (base $0.0083 plus carrier fee), $1.15 a month per local number, plus a one-time registration (about $4.50) and a monthly campaign fee

integrations.name: Email
integrations.method: WooCommerce emails stay; sales@mandmvinyl.com for the quote inbox
integrations.need: Nothing for the existing order emails.

unconfirmed: Kixxl data access and reseller pricing
